note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual data.

Please provide:
1) The transcript (paste the doctor–patient conversation in plain text).
2) The differential diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Notes:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx only if consistent with the transcript (marking “conflict noted” if there is a contradiction).
- I will extract only clinically relevant information (presenting complaint with onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, social history, physical findings, working/impression, plan, follow-up).
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- I will present the final note in the exact structure you requested:
  Subjective:
  Objective:
  Assessment & Plan:
  - Then per-issue blocks (Issue 1, Issue 2, etc.) with diagnoses, differentials, investigations, treatments, referrals as applicable.
  Quality checks at the bottom.

If you’d like, I can also provide a filled example template after you provide the data.
